text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Wait, isn't today...
the Hanshin Umamusume Stakes?
The GII race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Is it just me... or are there a ton of people here?

text_block_list.name: Craft Fan A
text_block_list.text:
I saw it in a magazine—Craft-chan
seems to be hitting her stride...!
She's definitely gonna win today!

text_block_list.name: Messiah's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No... Messiah-san, who showed such a fierce run in the Shuka Sho,
might just keep riding this momentum...!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Fan A
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Don't you dare underestimate Heart-san's
power in the mile! You all saw it too, right!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Even if everyone back home gathered,
would there be this many people...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Ah, you made it safely?
Good, take your time and enjoy yourself!”
choice_data_list: So you called for Takt, huh.
So you called for Takt, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! She seemed to be interested in the Tiara route, after all.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I thought today's race would be perfect!
—Because it lets me show off a fiery youth."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Together with Messiah!
Heheh...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Is this the first time all three of us have been together since the Shuka Sho?
I'm sure you two have gotten
even stronger since then.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I've grown too!
Enough to lead the two of you!”
choice_data_list: Your weight's pretty much back to normal, too.
Your weight's pretty much back to normal, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's all thanks to your eating regimen!
Thanks to that,
I've grown even more robust.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
With this mind and body I've polished to perfection—
I'm going to take them head-on!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-san! Did you see outside?
The hype is off the charts...!"

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna engrave my speed deep into the hearts of everyone gathered here today!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Looks like you're completely back in shape.
In fact, you seem brimming with confidence, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, my rival!
The stronger you are, the more my heart blazes...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey there, my other rival!
How are things going on your end?”

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text: Yes... Step by step, steadily moving forward... ever since the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: (...? Has Messiah's demeanor... softened a bit?)

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
"The way the two of them ran that day...
brought out my true strength."

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Next time, let us test... how far I can elevate
those around me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, look at you, acting all confident.
Too bad it won't go your way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take the lead—
so let's clash with everything we've got!"
